transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Hi. Um, well, the main reason I came in is that I just get pulled off track so easily. Like, I'll be working on an assignment or trying to finish up a project for school, and... I don't know, one notification on my phone, or even just a song lyric I hear, or a random idea for something completely different pops into my head, and suddenly I've just completely lost the thread of what I was supposed to be doing. It's really frustrating.
When did you first start noticing these difficulties with staying focused? Was this something that has been an issue for you since childhood?

Yeah, it's definitely been an issue since I was little. Um, even back in elementary school, my teachers were always writing comments on my report cards about me rushing through worksheets or just... losing track of directions. They also mentioned I'd talk over my classmates a lot during group work. 

And at home, my parents actually used to have to sit right beside me while I did my homework. If they didn't, I would just wander off or start doing something else entirely before I ever actually finished what I was working on. So, yeah, it's been going on for a long time.
Have you noticed that you still have problems with being impulsive or feeling restless, like you can't sit still for long periods of time?

Yeah, I definitely still feel restless. Um, like if I have to sit still through a long Zoom call for school, or if I'm just trying to quietly work in one place, I start feeling this... uncomfortable pressure in my body. It's almost like I just really need to get up and pace, or at least do something with my hands. It's just hard to stay completely still for very long.

Do you also find it hard to stay focused or feel restless in other situations, like when you’re hanging out with friends or trying to relax at home, or does this mainly happen when you’re working on school-related tasks?

Yeah, it's definitely not just school stuff. It happens when I'm just trying to relax at home, too. Like, even if I try to do something really calm, um, like reading a book or just doing a simple sketching exercise, I can't just... sit quietly with it. I always end up talking to myself, or I have to put music on, or I'll stop to check something on my phone. Or sometimes I'll even turn a quick sketch into this whole big, complicated project instead of just letting it be a relaxing, quiet thing. So, yeah, it happens pretty much everywhere.
